pages.name: introduction
pages.title: Self-Assessment Questionnaire – Introduction
pages.description: Global Assessment of the National Statistical System

elements.name: intro_text
elements.html:
You are invited to complete this self-assessment questionnaire as the first step in the Global Assessment of your country’s National Statistical System (NSS).

Your responses will help the international assessment team to better understand the strengths and challenges of the NSS and to identify areas for more in-depth discussion during the expert mission.

elements.name: scope_text
elements.html:
Scope of the questionnaire

Please answer the questions from the perspective of the National Statistical System (NSS) as a whole. This includes the national statistical office and all other producers of official statistics.

elements.name: structure_text
elements.html:
Structure

  • Part 1 – Institutional issues: legal framework, independence, coordination, resources, quality, confidentiality, and related topics.
  • Part 2 – Main statistical subject-matter domains: assessment of key statistical areas such as national accounts, price statistics, population statistics, and others.
  • Part 3 – Supporting documents: links or uploads of relevant laws, strategies, policies, and other background material.

elements.name: guidance_text
elements.html:
How to answer

  • Responses should be concise but informative. Bullet points are acceptable.
  • Please describe both the legal framework and the actual practice, where relevant.
  • If an issue or statistical domain is not applicable, please briefly explain why.
  • If information is not available at the time of completing the questionnaire, please indicate this.

elements.name: documents_text
elements.html:
Supporting documents

In Part 3, links to documents available online are preferred. If this is not possible, you may upload document files. Documents in English are preferred where available.
